comments.body:
8-item Album consisting of Treasure Hunt relic rewards obtained from various Treasure Hunt themes. The MA items are:

Golden Clip
Ancient Glass Fragment
Jack of Spades
Uncle Hoca
Ancient Flute
Lemegeton
Emerald Tablet
Picatrix

Details may be found on their pages and quest entries.

Album reported to: Cabral (Bahia)
Album Reward: Masquerade

Cheers.
